message.content:
ANSWER: YES
HALLUCINATIONS:
- Key Covenants: The memo states “Mortgage and Guaranty release upon full OCF repayment or by December 31, 2024.” The source provides a narrower condition: release occurs either (x) once the principal amount of the Operational Collection Floor is repaid in full, or (y) if the amounts drawn under the Operational Collection Floor as of December 31, 2024 are repaid in full by that date. It does not provide for an automatic release merely “by December 31, 2024.”

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS:
- Third-Party Sale Option mechanics: existence of sale option, requirement that Third Party Price exceed the Hazel Floor Price, definition/role of Hazel Floor Price, mandatory prepayment of the Operational Collection Floor from sale proceeds, and 50/50 split of excess proceeds (50% to MSP solely for Parent operating expenses; 50% to repay Term A and Term B pro rata).
- Partial (50%) sale option: ability to sell 50% (including to Virage on an arms-length basis), proceeds application (prepay OCF, then Term A/B), claims remain in New Claims Subsidiary, and 50% of collections thereafter available solely for MSP operating expenses.
- Upside participation condition: Hazel’s 50%/25% upside applies only after full repayment of the Operational Collection Floor and prior to any Third-Party Sale.
- Initial funding commitment: first two tranches totaling $3,500,000 funded on August 2, 2024 (covering July and August 2024 tranches), subject to draw conditions.
- Net-of-OID point: $16,000,000 OCF amount represents funds available to draw after deduction of original issue discount (OCF advances deemed Term Loan B), implying higher gross principal than $16MM.
- Collateral scope specifics for the [redacted] Claims: date-of-service window (Sept 30, 2017–July 23, 2024) with pre-9/30/2017 claims retained by MSP/Virage; transfer from Series 16-08-483 to the New Claims Subsidiary.
- Collateral detail: pledge includes [redacted] Claims, related case proceeds, all assets of the New Claims Subsidiary, and its membership interests, securing the Operational Collection Floor, Term A and Term B pro rata.
- Virage acknowledgment of Hazel’s first-priority security interest.
- New Claims Subsidiary to join the Credit Agreement as a “Credit Party.”
- Mortgage/Guaranty release qualifier: release occurs when OCF principal is repaid in full, or when drawn amounts under the OCF as of December 31, 2024 are repaid in full by that date (the memo omits the “drawn amounts as of 12/31/2024” qualifier).
